verdict.rationale: Hoppscotch is an API development platform that could plausibly publish official SDKs, so this axis applies, but the evidence pack documents none. It shows an official CLI, an MCP server and request code-snippet generation. Snippet generation is an adjacent feature for exporting individual requests, not an official SDK to build against, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
